## Release Notes

### New Features

#### Pre-Buff Hotkey

A new pre-buff hotkey has been added.

You can now create and save a full pre-buff routine for your character, then trigger the entire routine with one hotkey. This makes character preparation faster, cleaner, and more consistent before runs or services.

#### Spam Click with Control

Added spam-click functionality using Control.

This allows rapid item movement between:

* Stash to inventory
* Inventory to stash
* Floor to inventory
* Stash dropping

This is meant to make item handling much faster when moving, sorting, picking up, or dropping items.

#### In-Game Hotkey Popup

Added an embedded in-game popup that appears when a control/hotkey has been clicked.

This gives clear feedback that the hotkey fired correctly. The popup can be disabled in Settings if you prefer a cleaner in-game view.

#### Steam Loader Improvements

The Steam Loader has been improved.

It now works headless and client-less, opening the game directly in a similar way to Battle.net. This makes the Steam launch flow cleaner and more automatic.

#### Hideable Hotkeys

Hotkeys can now be hidden to keep the frontend clean.

You can right-click a hotkey and choose **Hide**. Hidden hotkeys can still be found later in the hidden-hotkey list, so the app stays organized without removing functionality.

---

### Team Assignment Improvements

#### Full Account Portfolio View

When creating or editing a team, you can now open your full account portfolio and assign members more easily.

#### Multi-Select Team Assignment

You can select the team or member you want, then click all relevant members in one go instead of assigning them one by one.

#### Faster Character Assignment

Characters can now be assigned to teams in one go, making team setup much faster.

#### Smarter Account Sorting

Accounts and characters are now sorted by ladder, core, and other relevant allocation rules.

This helps ensure that only characters matching the correct allocation can be assigned to the selected team.

#### Ladder Reset Button

Added a ladder reset button.

This changes all ladder-assigned characters back to non-ladder, making the setup ready to reuse after a ladder reset.

---

### Quality of Life

* Faster pre-run preparation with saved pre-buff routines.
* Faster item movement using Control spam-click.
* Clearer feedback when hotkeys fire.
* Cleaner frontend through hideable hotkeys.
* Better Steam launch handling.
* Faster and safer team setup.
* Easier transition after ladder reset.
